quarterly_data.signal: Nidec semi-annual report, first half ended September 30, 2025 (as filed in November 2025; the report states the third-party committee investigation and other internal investigations were still under way and any misstatements were not reflected in these interim statements): net sales JPY 1,302,303 million (+0.7%, a record), operating profit JPY 21,107 million (-82.5%) after an onerous-contract provision of JPY 36,471 million, impairment losses on non-financial assets of JPY 31,674 million and a JPY 19,495 million liability from settling a supplier's claim. Segments: SPMS sales JPY 196,121 million, operating profit JPY 27,343 million (up JPY 7,043 million); MOEN sales JPY 320,019 million (up JPY 41,918 million), operating profit JPY 14,048 million; AMEC operating loss JPY 71,718 million. Product groups: precision small motors JPY 242,329 million (-0.1%), of which HDD motors JPY 52,765 million (+8.3%) and other small motors JPY 189,564 million (-2.2%), operating profit JPY 34,886 million (+20.0%); appliance, commercial and industrial JPY 530,562 million (+2.0%), operating profit JPY 57,362 million (-1.5%). Production, orders and sales rose year on year mainly in the MOEN segment. H1 R&D expenses JPY 45,659 million.

quarterly_data.signal: Nidec semi-annual report (November 2025): the targets of the mid-term plan in force at the time, Conversion2027, for fiscal 2027 were consolidated net sales of JPY 2.9 trillion, operating profit of JPY 350 billion (12% operating margin) and ROIC of 12%; the plan set out three 'conversions' (to a high-profit structure, to five growth business pillars, and to a truly global structure), pursued through business restructuring, site consolidation and headcount reduction.
